status: Prospective before candidate comparison; all October-November outcomes are development evidence, never independent holdout
target: Gross positive recorded units with normalized status completed, shipped or returned; include Return_Flag Yes without subtracting or adding usable stock. Exclude cancelled, processing and nonpositive rows. Remove exact duplicate rows; conflicting Transaction_ID duplicates fail.
date_population: Daily dates are not automatically observed zeros. Conditional complete-extract assumption: after first recorded transaction for each product at store, no transaction in a complete Monday-Sunday week means zero recorded units, not zero customer demand. No pre-first-observation zeros. All 336 observed series are eligible by every evaluation origin; current stock population used only for deployment and coverage-rule mapping, with survivor limitation disclosed.
training: From first full Monday-Sunday week after first recorded transaction through origin inclusive; no post-origin quantities/features. Date calendar features known in advance. Recorded statuses lack old change dates; true as-of-label reconstruction unavailable for every method.
evaluation: 2025-09-29 through 2025-11-30, all development. Identical pairs, origins and targets for all candidates; no December outcomes accessed.

horizons.secondary_days: 8-14 for each pair from supplied current lead time plus seven-day review; historical policy not asserted. Forecast daily by weekly expected total / 7. Scores for coverage horizon overlap.

baseline.name: recent_8_week_mean
baseline.description: Per-pair last eight full weekly totals, arithmetic mean. Analytical baseline, not customer incumbent.

candidates.name: recent_8_week_mean
candidates.rationale: Fair responsive simple method; nonzero uncertainty despite many zero weeks.

candidates.name: croston_sba
candidates.rationale: Sparse positive events; separate smoothed event size and interarrival interval, fixed standard bias correction; no tuning.

candidates.name: pooled_poisson
candidates.rationale: Share product and store effects across sparse series, annual Fourier pair and linear year trend; weekly count regression, regularization, small dense design (~43 columns). No prices, inventory or later status-history features.

primary_metric: Mean absolute error, units per product at store per seven-day horizon; equal weights over all 336 pairs and eight origins (2688 predictions). Point forecast quantity error, not availability/cost/savings.
selection_rule: Smallest unrounded pooled primary MAE. Numerical tie within 1e-8 selects baseline then Croston then Poisson for simplicity. No business meaningfulness threshold is invented. Secondary coverage-horizon disagreement must be disclosed; no winner switching based on diagnostics.
secondary_diagnostics: Per-origin MAE and paired origin-block bootstrap uncertainty (8 origins, 2000 deterministic resamples; limited independent weeks)
zero week fraction and positive demand size
annual seasonal rates across complete years
alternative status treatment: completed/shipped only and all noncancelled positive orders, fixed selected method versus baseline only; exploratory, no reselection
baseline 4/13-week windows as exploratory selection sensitivity, no reselection
resource_evidence: Measure per-origin fit/inference time, full process peak RSS including preparation and retained arrays/models; separately measure actual routine subprocess wall, CPU and peak RSS on this host. Estimate 8 GB suitability from workload, not host capacity. No unbounded search.
frozen_scope: Single plan; any new scoring candidate requires prospective appended plan. No independent success claim; threshold and untouched outcomes absent.
